# Anbennar Overhaul: generated by tools/build_holding_models.py from Realms in Exile and Anbennar.
# Anbennar Overhaul: do not edit by hand; rerun the generator after an RiE or Anbennar update.

walls_00 = {
	is_graphical_background = yes

	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		name = "western_walls_00_mesh"
	}

	is_enabled = {
		OR = {
			aov_dwarven_model_province_trigger = yes # Anbennar Overhaul: dwarven holds
			AND = { # Anbennar Overhaul: walls by holding level
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { aov_holding_walls_level_3_trigger = yes aov_holding_walls_level_4_trigger = yes } }
					scope:holder ?= { government_has_flag = government_is_tribal }
				}
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						scope:holder ?= { culture = { OR = { has_building_gfx = aov_high_elf_building_gfx has_building_gfx = aov_wood_elf_building_gfx } } }
						OR = {
							is_county_capital = yes
							fort_level > 0
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_county_capital = no
				fort_level < 1
			}
			# Using the no_wall holding graphics for cities with special walls so that they don't have double walls
			# has_building_or_higher = "city_wall_of_toledo_01"			# Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "roman_wall_of_lugo_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "kano_walls_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "jaisalmer_fort_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "temples_angkor_01" #NOTE: the model gives its own unique set of walls to Angkor # Anbennar
			# Herders shouldn't have walls
			scope:holder = {
				government_has_flag = government_is_herder
			}
		}
	}
}

walls_01_tribal = {
	is_graphical_background = yes

	
	#Base Tribal Walls:
	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		names = {
			"tribal_walls_01_a_mesh"
		}
	}
	#Specific Tribal Walls:
	#Emishi:
	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		names = {
			"building_emishi_wall_01_mesh"
		}
		requires_dlc_flag = north_pacific_attire
		#Emishi GFX:
		graphical_cultures = { emishi_building_gfx amuric_building_gfx }
	}
	is_enabled = {
		always = no # Anbennar Overhaul: walls by holding level
		NOT = { scope:holder ?= { culture = { OR = { has_building_gfx = aov_high_elf_building_gfx has_building_gfx = aov_wood_elf_building_gfx } } } } # Anbennar Overhaul: elven walls
		NOT = { aov_dwarven_model_province_trigger = yes } # Anbennar Overhaul: dwarven holds
		OR = {
			is_county_capital = yes
			fort_level > 0
		}
		NOR = {
			# disabling this level of walled graphics for holdings with special walls and other fortifications so that they always look appropriately fortified. Note: If any of these buildings are given unique 3D assets, this should be looked at again.
			has_building_or_higher = "palisades_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "curtain_walls_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "hill_forts_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "ramparts_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "watchtowers_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "temple_citadel_01"
			# has_building_or_higher = "theodosian_walls_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "walls_of_benin_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "walls_of_genoa_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "aurelian_walls_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "city_wall_of_toledo_01" # Anbennar
			# has_building_or_higher = "roman_wall_of_lugo_01" # Anbennar
		}
		# Nomads use custom walls
		scope:holder = { NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic } }
	}
}

		always = no # Anbennar Overhaul: walls by holding level
		NOT = { scope:holder ?= { culture = { OR = { has_building_gfx = aov_high_elf_building_gfx has_building_gfx = aov_wood_elf_building_gfx } } } } # Anbennar Overhaul: elven walls
		NOT = { aov_dwarven_model_province_trigger = yes } # Anbennar Overhaul: dwarven holds
		OR = {
			# These buildings will trigger the visual "upgrade" to this wall asset

			has_building_or_higher = "curtain_walls_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "hill_forts_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "ramparts_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "watchtowers_01"
			has_building_or_higher = "temple_citadel_01"
			scope:holder = {
				government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic
				root = { fort_level = 1 }
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			# Disabling this level of walled graphics for holdings with special walls and other fortifications so that they always look appropriately fortified. Note: If any of these buildings are given unique 3D assets, this should be looked at again.
